_comment: Hand-authored RE input for the script-globals subsystem (the despawn-global
MP-cars-in-SP fix). Unlike the native table, these anchors are NOT resolved by
the crossmap join -- they are version-specific machine addresses reverse-
engineered once per game build from the PS5 eboot with a disassembler, then
baked into a generated header by devtools/generators/generate_script_globals_header.py.
Set each anchor's "addr" to the absolute live virtual address (the eboot maps
at its fixed link base with no ASLR slide, so the disassembler vaddr is the
live VA). Leave it null until RE'd; a null anchor emits 0 and the runtime
latches FAILED rather than dereferencing null. See docs/script-globals-design.md.
_targetIdComment: Production anchors for the only active build. The 01.005.000 source and analysis inputs are
preserved on private dev; its verified historical build is tagged
Both the globals base and global indices move between builds; never reuse these values.
